subject.title: fix(install): bound curl connection setup with --connect-timeout 20

question: Should the curl installer path adopt the wget-aligned 20-second connection-setup limit despite making exceptionally slow DNS, proxy, TCP, or TLS establishment fail after retries?
rationale: The implementation and runtime transcript establish the intended bound, but selecting a hard cutoff changes the outcome for a narrow class of previously eventual-success installations and is a product reliability tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt wget-aligned 20 seconds
options.body: Rebase the branch and accept a 20-second per-attempt curl connection bound to prevent indefinite installer hangs while preserving the existing transfer grace window.

options.title: Retain unbounded curl setup
options.body: Close or revise the change if preserving eventual completion on very slow connection setup is more important than bounding blackholed connections.

recommendation.title: Adopt wget-aligned 20 seconds
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and accept a 20-second per-attempt curl connection bound to prevent indefinite installer hangs while preserving the existing transfer grace window.

likelyOwner.reason: Only low-confidence repository-process evidence is available in the supplied context, so this is a routing suggestion rather than established ownership of the installer code.
